text: I've overheard and glimpsed so much, but haven't dared to gather physical evidence. But I'm sure it's there. Derek's sloppy. He thinks he's untouchable.
style: Content analyst in her late twenties. Speak with a consistent Chinese-American (California) accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Soft, mid-to-high pitch; quiet, hesitant pace. Nervous and concerned.
